The backyard compost is a **two-bin hot rotation** in the north corner behind the shed. Bin A is the active pile, Bin B is curing. Turn the active pile **weekly** and keep a **browns:greens ratio of about 3:1** (dry leaves and cardboard against kitchen scraps and grass).

**How to apply:** when adding a lot of green material at once, add a matching volume of shredded cardboard to hold the ratio. Related: [[patio-umbrella-warranty]].
